pub mod l3


The consolidated L3 document store.

L3 is the per-consumer projection layer: questions, selections, annotations, and domain edges that point at canonical ids in the store's L1/L2 layers. These commands edit the docs behind the machine-local store directly: plain markdown files — one <doc>.l3.md per item — consolidated under a single, config-driven root that the local server also serves over /api/l3/docs. Research Documents are local files; cross-store synchronization is not a CLI concern.

The contract is deliberately split in two:

Frontmatter (required): a small set of keys the tooling reads to file, find, and index a doc without parsing its body — doc. REQUIRED_FRONTMATTER is the single place that grows over time.Body (free): everything below the frontmatter, written in one shared node grammar (see doc02.01.04 in .rhidoc/) that every doc follows.

Two row shapes reach here: a store row (WorkView), whose identity is canonical_id and whose title lives under attrs; and a provider row, which carries provider-native top-level keys (a provider row has no canonical id — it is not yet in the store). canonical_id and id both name the work's identity, resolved as canonical_id first so a store row never reports a provider id as its identity; title falls back to attrs.title.
